purpose: Continue the three-session offline research program after Campaign005 ended with zero development survivors. This record scouts only mechanism meaning and source-schema feasibility, rejects near-synonyms of terminal factors before values, and selects at most one concept for a separate exact no-value overlap audit.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: This would re-express terminal return-sign runs, diffusive-variation ratio, return-variance entropy, or the already terminal directional-serial-dependence family rather than introduce a new economic mechanism.
This is a timing transform of terminal volatility resolution and late-return or terminal-location families.
Signed or lagged market correlation is too close to a forbidden reformulation of terminal market-idiosyncratic share and Campaign004 market-neutral residual drift.
Campaign005 terminally consumed the zero-return activity-absorption mechanism; changing its spell, threshold, window, or normalization would be a prohibited rescue.
Amount entropy, serial persistence, center of mass, auction share, late amount share, and market profile synchronization already exhaust this direct profile family.

selected_concept.mechanism: Compare the minute-to-minute path implied by executed CNY value per share with the observed minute-close path. Agreement would measure whether closing-price changes are confirmed by the path of transaction prices, rather than whether closes merely sit above a daily or bar VWAP level.
selected_concept.economic_question: Does broad same-session agreement between transaction-price changes and minute-close changes identify price discovery supported by executed flow that remains informative from the next open through the third close?
known_design_risks: amount divided by volume has provider-unit scaling, although a return-path construction can be invariant to any constant unit multiplier
inactive bars can make the transaction-price path incomplete
correlation can be undefined when either return path has no variation
level-gap, sign-agreement, lead-lag, weighting, and window choices would create formula search
the concept may still prove empirically redundant with the terminal bar-VWAP or close-path mechanisms

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against every frozen comparison mechanism. Only if the concept remains economically distinct may that audit freeze one exact formula, one direction, missing semantics, gates, and a finite trial catalog before any candidate or comparison value or return is read.
